question: Na palubnej doske býva pri ikonke benzínovej pumpy malá šípka. Čo vodičovi prezrádza?
alternative_answers: Na ktorej strane je palivové hrdlo
source_excerpt: That little arrow next to the fuel pump icon on your fuel gauge tells you exactly which side of the car the fuel filler door is on.

extra.why_interesting: Drivers look at this icon every day and many never notice the tiny arrow. Once they hear what it means, they want to check it in their own car right away. It also solves a familiar moment: pulling up to the wrong side of the pump in a rented or borrowed car.
extra.verification_notes: The arrow beside the fuel pump icon indicates which side the fuel filler door is on, per https://www.motor1.com/news/804101/what-fuel-gauge-arrow-means/.

explanation: Šípka ukazuje, na ktorej strane auta je viečko nádrže. Najviac sa zíde v požičanom aute, aby ste k stojanu nezastavili z nesprávnej strany.

question: Nové pneumatiky majú po povrchu drobné gumené „chĺpky“. Prečo tam vlastne sú?
source_excerpt: Air must escape through tiny vent holes so the rubber fills every detail of the tread pattern, and a little rubber follows the air out.

extra.why_interesting: Everyone who has changed tyres or walked past a tyre shop has seen these 'hairs'. Most people never ask why they are there, or they guess they are wear indicators or decoration. The real reason is simple and easy to picture: air has to get out of the mould. Players can reason their way to it.
extra.verification_notes: Tire whiskers (vent spews) are rubber that fills the mold's vent holes through which air escapes during molding; the claimed answer matches, though it is loosely worded (https://www.jalopnik.com/1806094/new-tires-little-rubber-hairs-reason/).

explanation: Pri výrobe sa guma lisuje do horúcej formy a vzduch z nej uniká drobnými otvormi. Guma do nich trochu zatečie, a tak vzniknú chĺpky. Jazdu nijako neovplyvňujú a časom sa zodrú.
